verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the RTX 5090 product page, which promotes "NVIDIA Studio creator tools and technology" and says the card can accelerate creating. That is a glancing nod to creator-app acceleration, with no specifics on media engines or drivers. Missing for 10: any documentation of AV1/HEVC hardware encoders or decoders, encoder counts or quality, Studio or ISV-certified driver details, named creator-app acceleration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
